meaning: User-allocated historical recommendation increments replacing the previous 578-count repository-wide historical baseline. Live v2 recommendation counts are added separately and are not changed. Zero or blank allocation means no historical increment for that plugin.

source.inputMethod: XLSX XML literal D-column inputs; formula cached values not used; blank plugin input equals zero.

readinessBasis: Source workbook matches the extracted data; all 239 plugin inputs are valid and no repository is overallocated. Unused budget remains unused and is not a requirement to allocate.
authorizationBasis: Apply the saved user-completed workbook exactly, using the previously authorized blank=zero rule. Do not infer a distribution for unused budget.
